Welcome Home

Where the Anointing Breaks Every Yoke.

St. Pauls Deliverance Center (SPDC) is more than a church — it's a family, a refuge, and a launching pad for destiny. Whether you're seeking healing, hope, or a deeper walk with Christ, you'll find a place to belong here.

We believe in the power of the Holy Spirit to transform lives. Our doors are open to all who hunger for the presence of God.

✦ Our Story · SPDC

About Our House

A house built on faith, fueled by the Spirit, and committed to the harvest of souls.

Our Mission

Carrying the Gospel With Power.

St. Pauls Deliverance Center exists to be a beacon of God's love in our community and a sending station for laborers into the global harvest. We are passionate about discipleship, deliverance, and dynamic encounters with the Holy Spirit.

Founded on the unshakeable Word of God, SPDC stands firmly upon the apostolic foundations: prayer, evangelism, signs, and wonders. Every soul matters. Every life can be transformed.

Our Sanctuary
📖

Faith

We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God — our final authority for life and faith.

🔥

The Spirit

We embrace the present-day move of the Holy Spirit with gifts, healing, and deliverance for all.

🤝

Community

We are family — bearing one another's burdens, celebrating victories, and walking together.

🌍

Mission

We go — into our city, our region, and the nations — proclaiming Jesus Christ as Lord.

Pastor Maurice McCormick

"For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power." — 1 Corinthians 4:20

Pastor Maurice McCormick is the founding shepherd of St. Pauls Deliverance Center, called by God to lead a people into deep relationship with Jesus Christ and bold demonstration of His power.

With a heart for the broken, the lost, and the hungry, Pastor McCormick ministers the Word with clarity, conviction, and compassion.

Quick Actions

Hero Page Themes

Choose the layout and visual style of your homepage hero — the big banner at the top of the page.

💡 How it works

Each theme changes the layout of your homepage banner — the big section at the top. Pick one below and it applies immediately. Some themes have special features like a flyer slot or a dark cross background.

📰 Hero Pages (full-width carousel)

Musical and Community Day flyers are published on the live site for every visitor. Extra uploads in Admin stay on this browser until you download (⬇) them and we add them to assets/hero/.

Page slide speed 7 sec 0 = manual only
🎛 Flyer look

Control the frame, size, and background around your flyers. Changes apply immediately on the homepage.

Tip: Nothing is locked — delete what you don’t want, then add your own flyers. Prefer JPG under ~3MB.

🖼 Hero Event Flyers (Announce theme)

Add multiple upcoming-event flyers for the hero carousel. Same poster size, larger display, swipe/arrow navigation, optional click links, and a slide-speed timer.

Slide speed 5 sec 0 = manual only
Changes save automatically — use Save for confirmation.

Tip: Upload Flyer adds images to the homepage right away. Use ↑ ↓ to reorder. Titles/links save as you type. Prefer JPG under ~3MB for fastest uploads.

AI Site Assistant

Chat with your AI helper — it can design flyers, write emails, update content, change themes, and more.

👋 Hello! I'm your SPDC AI Assistant. I can:

🎨 Design flyers — "Create an Easter flyer"
📧 Draft emails — "Write a fundraising email"
🎙 Add content — "Add a sermon called The Power of Prayer"
🌈 Change themes — "Switch to Christmas theme"
✏️ Edit anything — "Update the pastor bio"
📅 Create events — "Add a youth conference for June 15"
